summary: Frontend testing of Aviation Exchange Phase 2 features: featured spotlight strip, mode toggle (Buy/Fractional), fractional reservation flow (logged-in + logged-out), Seller Dashboard (My Aircraft), Admin Exchange management (feature toggle, EOI approve/reject/mark contacted), regression on Sell Aircraft dialog + search. All new features functional. One critical routing bug found & fixed: /customer/listings had no Route registered in App.js, causing the My Aircraft nav item to blank the page. After fix, the seller dashboard renders correctly with all data-testids present.

ui_bugs.issue: Missing <Route path='/customer/listings'>; clicking 'My Aircraft / मेरे विमान' nav item rendered a blank page and React Router warned 'No routes matched location /customer/listings'. Fixed by adding the Route. Main agent should double-check similar new nav additions.

action_items: Review App.js customer routes: ensure every navGroups[].items[].path has a matching <Route>. Consider using a single <Route path='/customer/*'> wildcard so sidebar-driven paths never 404 again.
Optional cleanup: delete leftover test EOI reservation (Airbus H145 VIP, 1 share, message 'Interested in fractional test', phone +919999999999, from loyaltytest@airyatra.com) created during testing.
critical_code_review_comments: CustomerDashboard nav items should be validated against declared routes at build/test time — or refactored to a nested <Route path='/customer/*'> with child routes.
Admin ExchangeManagement 'Mark Contacted' action shows no toast confirmation on success; consider adding a toast for consistency with feature-toggle / approve actions.

rca_of_the_issue: Developer added a new sidebar nav item ({id:'mylistings', path:'/customer/listings'}) in CustomerDashboard.js and wired the tab render, but forgot to add the corresponding top-level <Route path='/customer/listings' element={<CustomerDashboard/>}/> in App.js. Because the /customer/* routes are declared one-per-path (not wildcard), the new path returned no match and rendered a blank layout. Fix: added the Route entry alongside /customer/messages.
